question: On a newly frozen all-eligible OKX crypto USDT-swap snapshot, which unchanged Grade-A YOLO proposals survive the unchanged causal semantic gate on the latest 15m and 1h endpoints and on the latest 15 days of 4h and UTC-daily endpoints, and how should they be ordered for human chart review without treating cross-timeframe confidence as a calibrated probability?

verbatim: 用模型跑一下最新的行情 1h 4h 日线 15min 这几个周期的  4h 日线级别的允许信号已经出来15天以内  然后针对结果做排序给我看图
owner_authorization.interpreted_action: Authorize one fresh, read-only OKX crypto completed-history inference configuration for each explicitly named timeframe. Scan only the latest closed endpoint for 15m and 1h; allow 4h and UTC-daily event onsets from the latest 15 days; rank only as a human-review queue; render charts. This is not final acceptance, production activation, a threshold experiment, or an order instruction.

single_variable_bundle: Owner explicitly requested the four descriptive timeframe configurations together. Across all four, universe, checkpoint, renderer, W18/W19, confidence, NMS, structural core/post contract, semantic thresholds, five-bar event spacing and no-production status are fixed. Only the market bar clock and the requested endpoint lookback differ: latest-only for 15m/1h and 15 days for 4h/1d.

universe.rule: Freeze every current live instCategory=1 crypto USDT swap with a positive ticker; exclude repository BLOCKED_BASES and STOCKISH_BASES.
universe.ranking_context_only: Current 24h price change and estimated quote volume may be displayed but must not enter model inference, semantic acceptance, or primary review ordering.
universe.missing_or_stale_action: Fail that symbol-timeframe closed and receipt the exclusion; do not substitute another venue, synthesize bars, forward-fill, or relax continuity.

source_contract.latest_closed_rule: floor scan_frozen_at to the timeframe boundary, then subtract one full interval
source_contract.continuity: Every adjacent open_time difference must equal the exact timeframe interval.
source_contract.ohlcv: All open/high/low/close/volume values must be finite; OHLC must be positive.

detector.name: Grade-A 8k positives + 24k matched negatives, full40, native 1280

semantic_gate.causality: Physically slice each frame at window_end_i before computing features. Future delivery candles never enter acceptance.
semantic_gate.null_control: For every structural box, preserve candles, box, confidence and class ID while flipping only LONG/SHORT inside the semantic calculation; report paired exact sign-test survival.

ranking.policy: same-direction distinct timeframe count descending; total distinct timeframe count descending; timeframe priority 1d > 4h > 1h > 15m; detector-confidence rank within its own timeframe; recency; stable symbol tie-break
ranking.confidence_semantics: Detector confidence is neither win probability nor return expectation and is not calibrated across timeframes.
ranking.direction_conflict: Preserve and visibly flag symbols with both LONG and SHORT events; do not average or silently choose a side.
